prompt: I am thinking of a movie where Hans Zimmer won a Grammy Award for his work. He won the Grammy award the same year that he did his first musical score for film director Michael Bay. Can you please tell me the name of that movie?
answer: The movie was **_Crimson Tide_ (1995)**. Hans Zimmer won the **1996 Grammy Award for Best Instrumental Composition Written for a Motion Picture or Television** for its score—the same year he made his first film-score collaboration with Michael Bay, **_The Rock_**.
